# Tom Binet

Tom Binet is the current Deputy of [District 7](https://flow.je/elections/district-7) and was first elected to the States of Jersey in 2022.

Tom Binet has participated in 1 election since 2002:

- [**2022 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/tom-binet#e48)

  Elected as Deputy of District 7 with 46.8% of the ballot.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/tom-binet/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SJYbBkOoM8w)

Tom Binet has declared his intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Senators Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/04/22/health-minister-to-stand-for-senator/)\]
